Halloween 2025

One night. Three hundred people. A story Austin is still telling.

Halloween 2025 - A Rabbit Hole Production

If you were there last Halloween, you felt it.

If you missed it, you heard about it for months. This year, you get to be part of the story.

This year, the gate opens for a curated 200… and you're on the list.

This is a curated guest list. Everyone here was invited because we trust them to care for the room and the people in it.

Alcohol-free, by design. Two hundred people fully present, dancing until sunrise, and waking up Sunday feeling incredible.

Welcome, epic being.

You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.

On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Austin to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.

This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.

This event is your canvas,and your gifts are the paint.

Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!

Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your essence.

As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, how to buy tickets, ride-sharing options and parking.

See you on the other side…Michael Pullano & Austin Dance Temple

October 31 into November 1

The Flow

  1. 7:00 to 8:00 PM

    The Arrival

    Step through the gate into an estate transformed for one night. Get your portrait taken by our professional photographer, wander the grounds, and take in a crowd of people who came to play. Doors close at 8 sharp so the whole room crosses together.

  2. 8:00 to 8:30 PM

    The Gathering

    Two hundred of us gather outside under the night sky. This is the moment a room full of costumes becomes one community.

  3. 8:30 PM

    The Crossing

    An opening ceremony created for this night only, led by Leah Free. We set the tone, name how we'll care for each other, and cross the veil together. Nobody walks into this party alone.

  4. 9:00 PM to sunrise

    The Night

    Two stages of Austin's best DJs, bass and house, from 9 until the sun comes up. Phones go away at 9, so you're fully in it, with nothing between you and the music.

  5. Through the night

    The Performances

    This isn't a house party with a playlist. Catch Spooky Halloween Story Time with Brent Pella, a comedy experience, and a live song and dance performance by Natalie Porretta and Zoe Dane.

  6. Midnight

    The Witching Hour

    A special performance at the stroke of midnight. We're not telling you what it is. You'll want to be on the dance floor when it starts.

  7. 2:00 AM

    The Extra Hour

    The clocks fall back. While the rest of the city gets an extra hour of sleep, you get an extra hour on the dance floor.

  8. Sunrise, about 6:45 AM

    First Light

    Sunshine plays the sunrise set as the sky over the hills turns gold. You'll greet the first morning of November with the people who danced through the night beside you.

Your costume

Outfit / Dress

This night is asking you to GO BIG, so treat your costume creation as part of the experience, not an afterthought.

The light side of the veil

This isn't a typical Halloween. We're crossing into the luminous side of the spirit realm: angels, celestial beings, starlight, moon goddesses. Think uplifting, radiant and beautiful, not dark and dreary.

Bring the light

  • Angelic, celestial, luminous
  • Iridescent, pearl, silver, chrome, gold
  • Wings, halos, crowns, sheer veils
  • Fae and faun looks welcome
  • Glitter, gems, light-catching makeup

Leave at home

  • Blood, gore, fake wounds
  • Vampires, zombies, demons, horror characters
  • Skulls and scary masks

Already planned something darker? No stress. Keep the base and lift it toward the light: swap the blood for shimmer, and add silver, pearl, a halo, wings or a veil.

Love wearing black? Bring it, just let it catch the light.

  • Plan ahead. Start now, use the moodboard and Etsy idea links below, and order anything you need early so you're not scrambling at the last moment for a long-shot Etsy delivery.
  • Go big, be bold. Step out of your comfort zone, and show up as the version of you that finally got the permission slip to be unapologetically yourself.
  • Dress for the whole night. You'll be moving through different energies and spaces and even spending time outdoors at times, so wear layers you can shed as it unfolds. We'll have plenty of places for coats, bags and your extra items to be stored.

Fair warning

A last-minute costume-in-a-bag from Amazon IS NOT what we're doing here. If you show up in a zero-effort onesie, expect to be playfully roasted and sent to the costume corner to change before you cross the veil.

You got this... we believe in you! ;)

Getting there

The Venue

Beyond the Veil is hosted at HAVAN, a private estate in west Austin/Lakeway chosen for its beauty, intimacy and spaciousness.

HAVAN 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738 Open in Maps

Event Start

Please arrive during the arrival window (7 to 8 PM) to preserve the integrity and flow of the experience.

Doors open
7 PM
Doors close
8 PM

Parking

Parking at HAVAN is very limited, so we're offering a small number of parking passes for $50 per car. Add one to your order at checkout.

Only cars with a parking pass will be allowed on the property, so if you don't have one, please rideshare or arrange a drop-off.

Ridesharing

We strongly encourage rideshare, carpools, and drop-offs. HAVAN sits in a remote part of the hills outside Austin, and finding a ride home late at night or early in the morning can be difficult, so please arrange your ride home before you arrive.

To make it easier, we've created a WhatsApp group just for Beyond the Veil guests. Join it to coordinate carpools to and from HAVAN.

Quick answers

Questions

Who is this for?

Our curated community, 21 and over. Bring your ID.

Can I bring a plus-one?

No, every invitation is personal. If you're attending, you can nominate and sponsor someone, and our team will review it.

Who can nominate a guest?

Only people who are attending. When you nominate someone, you sponsor them: you vouch for them and you're responsible for how they show up.

When should I arrive?

Between 7 and 8 PM; doors close at 8. The opening ceremony starts at 8:30.

Can I leave and come back?

No, there's no re-entry once you're inside.

When does it end?

Music runs until sunrise, around 6:45 AM. Leave whenever you like, but book your ride home before you arrive.

Is there alcohol?

No, this is an alcohol-free event. Please leave outside alcohol at home.

Will there be food?

A grazing table, water and non-alcoholic drinks, plus tea service by Casa Akasha. It's not a dinner, so eat a nourishing meal first.

Where is it?

HAVAN, 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738. It's a private estate in the hills of west Austin and Lakeway.

How do I get there?

Rideshare, carpool or get dropped off. Join the guest WhatsApp group to share rides.

Can I park on site?

Only with a $50 parking pass, added at checkout. Cars without one won't be allowed on the property.

Will there be a photographer?

Yes, professional photography is provided at the beginning of the night.

Are there house rules?

Yes: a short group agreement built on consent, plus a few practical notes on phones, shoes and pets. It's all in the Party Guide. Read the Party Guide

What should I wear?

Go big in iridescent, metallic, pearl, chrome, silver or gold. Light, not dark: no blood, gore or horror looks. Zero-effort costumes get sent to the costume corner.

Can I transfer my ticket?

Yes, you can transfer it to a friend. Email us and we'll take care of it.

What if it sells out?

A waitlist opens. Guests who are attending can also nominate and sponsor people.

What's LoveStack?

A supplement protocol by VESSEL, our official supplement partner. Add it to your ticket for 20% off and pick it up when you arrive.

Still wondering? Email beyondtheveil.atx@gmail.com.
